provenance_caveats: Historical seven-run manifest numeric metadata says 36/18 while its strategy text/report says main37/19; preserve both, join only by binary SHA d9fa50034d1935b87ee4a1ab1f73ec762fa63b0e0f3835ffe4778f3e0fd8e780.
Source commits in reports may describe later commits; exact session build commit/dirty and compiled source list are preserved separately. No dirty build is reconstructed from commit alone.
